correctness.rationale: Every code equals a clique in the finite compatibility graph of 11-avoiding unbordered words. The explicitly supplied greedy-colored exact branch-and-bound checks all cliques or removes branches only under valid clique-size upper bounds. Every possible word and pair of overlaps is generated, and string-slicing edges are independently rechecked by integer masks. Replay of the complete package proves capacities 30 at length 15 and 42 at length 16, checks every smaller size, and checks a 42-word codebook; n16 visits 308053 nodes.

value.rationale: Five payload bits require at least 32 non-overlapping words, yielding the natural exact minimum blocklength 16 under an asymmetric internal source restriction. The 42-word optimum gives a real extra bit compared with the best 24-word fixed-zero-marker subfamily, not a tiny arbitrary numeric gain. The complete all-shorter capacity table and explicit optimal witnesses provide a reproducible finite design benchmark. A general asymptotic theorem is not claimed.
